$comment: Cross-language conformance fixture for the Activity board-column table.
Every Activity surface groups agent items into the Work board's four
columns: needs_you, working, waiting, done. The mapping is implemented
three times because the surfaces cannot share code: the desktop and web
renderer (TypeScript), the iOS app and widgets (Swift), and the push relay
(a hermetic Cloudflare Worker that imports nothing from this repo). Each
implementation runs these cases through its own mapper.
changes, change it there, update these cases, and let the other suites
`boardColumn` is what the publishing brain wrote; null means an older brain
that does not send it. `tier` is the item's activityTier. `expected` null
means the item is not counted in any column.

cases.name: a published column wins over the phase
a published done wins over a raised hand
an unknown published column falls back to the phase
a failure is the user's move
a failure stays Needs you on the idle tier
a quiet run is still Working
a resting roster row is Done
an idle-tier running row is Done
a legacy item with no tier still maps
a pull request is never counted
a pull request ignores a stray column
